SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.email, m.name, m.dept_id, m.grade, m.major, m.double_major, m.intro, m.approved, m.account_status, m.profile_public, m.role, m.provider, m.provider_id, m.created_at, ud.univ_name, ud.dept_name FROM member m LEFT JOIN univ_department ud ON m.dept_id = ud.dept_id
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR m.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR ud.univ_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR ud.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') )
AND ( UPPER(m.account_status) = 'PENDING' OR ( m.approved = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mentor mt WHERE mt.member_id = m.member_id) AND UPPER(IFNULL(m.account_status, '')) NOT IN ('SUSPENDED', 'WITHDRAWN') ) )
AND UPPER(m.account_status) = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT ( m.approved = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mentor mt WHERE mt.member_id = m.member_id) )
AND UPPER(m.account_status) = UPPER(#{status})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mentor mt WHERE mt.member_id = m.member_id) AND UPPER(IFNULL(m.role, 'USER')) != 'ADMIN'
AND UPPER(IFNULL(m.role, 'USER')) = 'USER' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mentor mt WHERE mt.member_id = m.member_id)
AND UPPER(m.role) = UPPER(#{role})
ORDER BY m.member_id DESC LIMIT #{amount} OFFSET #{offset}
